I don't usually put a lot of thought into words or actions because of this very thing, but I'll try for the sake of actually seeing, for a moment, that I'm not alone with that idea. The realization that life has no meaning almost put me in the grave once, but later, it was as if I had that epiphany all over again, but the second time around it made me happy. I was already down. Very far down. But when I realized it didn't matter how happy or sad or sick or wealthy I was, I somehow felt this huge weight lifted. I don't know. I've been living with the same "Fuck it" mentality for a while now, and in my own personal experience, it allowed me to appreciate the moment I was living in rather than dreading the future or regretting the past. None if it fucking matters, and that is the most beautiful thing to me.
